details: Bitcoin dropped below the $75,000 mark to $74,344 in the early hours of Saturday, leading to nearly $1 billion in crypto futures liquidations across the market within 24 hours. Long positions, betting on price increases, were predominantly impacted. Other major cryptocurrencies, including Ethereum and Solana, also experienced declines.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $75K, Triggers $1 Billion Liquidations

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) recorded their most significant weekly net outflows since late January, totaling $1.26 billion. This marks a six-day consecutive outflow streak. Additionally, spot Ethereum funds also experienced their tenth consecutive day of outflows.
title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs See $1.26B Outflows in Worst Week Since January

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) has cautioned EU finance ministers that any relaxation of liquidity requirements for euro-denominated stablecoin issuers could potentially destabilize traditional bank funding and hinder the effectiveness of interest rate transmissions.
title: ECB Warns Against Easing Euro Stablecoin Regulations

details: Fenwick & West, the former law firm for FTX US, has agreed to a $54 million settlement, and auditor Prager Metis will pay $11.75 million, collectively amounting to approximately $66 million. These settlements aim to address customer claims related to the fraud that led to the collapse of the FTX exchange.
title: FTX's Former Firms Settle Fraud Claims for $66 Million

details: According to Binance Market Data, Bitcoin's price surged past $77,000 USDT, marking a 2.20% increase over the last 24 hours. Concurrently, BNB also saw a significant rise, crossing the $660 USDT threshold with a 3.11% gain within the same period.
title: Bitcoin Breaks $77K, BNB Above $660 in Market Rebound

details: A recent research report by Grayscale identified Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, and Canton Network as four prominent blockchain networks that are well-positioned to benefit from anticipated clearer U.S. digital asset regulations, particularly with the potential passage of the CLARITY Act.
title: Grayscale: CLARITY Act to Boost Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, Canton Network
